2026_04_LA_PHI.headline: Nacua’s return meets a depleted Eagles skill group as Donald sits
2026_04_LA_PHI.paragraph1: Puka Nacua returns after missing two games, restoring Matthew Stafford’s most dynamic underneath and intermediate target alongside Davante Adams. Los Angeles must compensate on the other side of the ball with Aaron Donald ruled out because of his back, putting more pressure on Chris Shula’s remaining front to disrupt Jalen Hurts. Philadelphia has significant absences of its own: DeVonta Smith and Dallas Goedert are out, thinning the receiving structure around Hurts and changing how the Eagles can challenge the Rams’ secondary.
2026_04_LA_PHI.model_rationale: Los Angeles regains a major receiving weapon, while Philadelphia’s missing pass catchers and the Rams’ Donald-less front create competing personnel stresses that should shape both game plans.
